description: One MCP seek, both halves of the contract. agentSeek is what an agent posts; desktopReport is the exact body the window posts after its seek (seq 1 stands for the bus seq the server assigned); agentResult is what ui_playback then returns. apps/desktop/tests/play-control.test.ts and crates/gen-audio-mcp/src/lib.rs both load this file.
